繁體中文版

各位高雄的夥伴同學、老師，大家好！這份文件介紹我們為 ASEP 2026 做的小程式，也想請大家幫忙檢查程式裡的繁體中文（見第 5 節）。我們不是台灣人，中文是我們請 AI 協助寫成的初稿，一定有不自然的地方，非常需要你們的協助。謝謝！🙏

1. 這是什麼？

我的動態，我的鏡子是一個小型網頁程式，不需要網路就能使用。它模擬社群媒體的「動態消息」，讓使用者按下 👀 ❤️ 🔁 ⏭️ 🚫，立刻看到動態怎麼跟著改變。

它想讓大家看見五件事：

1. 我的動作會改變動態。
看、讚、分享、略過，都會影響下一則貼文。
2.「為什麼我會看到這個？」
每則貼文都會列出具體理由，沒有任何祕密。
3.「完美貼文」的背後
可能有濾鏡、修圖、重拍很多次、付費推廣。
4. 鏡子檢查
動態認為你最在意什麼？那真的是你嗎？
5. 重寫挑戰。一個已經偏向「外表與比較」的動態，你能在 12 個動作內把它調整回來嗎？

另外還有學習畫面（6 張卡片），說明各平台自己是怎麼介紹推薦機制的，每張卡片都標示資料來源。

適合誰、什麼時候用？

  • 國中七、八年級同學，以及來參觀 STEM 攤位的同學，每次約 3–5 分鐘。
  • 可在筆電或平板上使用（完全離線），另有「簡報模式」方便投影和錄影。
  • 活動主題：「Breaking the Algorithm, Rewriting Youth: Youth Building a Safer Campus Ecosystem」。

四個安全承諾

承諾意思
🔒 沒有帳號不用登入，也不會要求輸入姓名或任何個人資料。
🧹 不儲存任何東西沒有 cookie，也不使用瀏覽器儲存空間。重新整理頁面，一切就回到最初。
📴 不需要網路不會向網際網路傳送或下載任何東西。關掉 Wi-Fi 也能用。
🎭 所有貼文都是虛構的40 則虛構貼文，沒有真人照片、真實人名或真實品牌，圖片只用表情符號。

2. 如何開啟

我們會用電子郵件寄給你們一個檔案：my-feed-my-mirror-offline.html（程式本體，約 65 KB）。所有內容都在這一個檔案裡，不需要網路。

  1. 把郵件附件下載到電腦（例如「下載」或「桌面」資料夾）。請先下載，不要直接在郵件的預覽視窗裡開，因為預覽視窗通常不能執行程式，只會看到空白頁。
  2. 在下載好的檔案上按兩下。它會用瀏覽器（Chrome、Safari、Edge）開啟。
  3. 看到開始畫面，有先學習和開始玩兩個按鈕，就成功了。之後就算關掉 Wi-Fi，也能照常使用。
如果遇到問題：
  • 按兩下後是用文字編輯器或其他程式開啟：在檔案上按右鍵，選「開啟方式」，再選 Chrome 或 Safari。
  • 你們的信箱或學校網路擋掉 .html 附件：我們也會附上 ZIP 版 my-feed-my-mirror-offline.zip。解壓縮後，再對裡面的 .html 檔按兩下。
  • 手機和平板：建議使用筆電或桌上型電腦。手機的郵件 App 通常無法直接執行（我們還沒有在手機上測試過）。
⚠️ 如果是在郵件或聊天軟體的「預覽視窗」裡開啟，可能只會看到空白頁，因為那種視窗不能執行 JavaScript。請務必用真正的瀏覽器開啟。

語言、重新開始、簡報模式

  • EN | 繁中（右上角）：在英文和繁體中文之間切換，貼文內容也會一起切換。（目前沒有越南文。）
  • 重新開始：回到開始畫面，從頭來過。
  • 簡報模式：在瀏覽器網址列的最後面加上 ?presenter=1（例如 …/my-feed-my-mirror-offline.html?presenter=1）再按 Enter。文字和畫面會變大，動畫也比較慢，適合投影和錄影。

3. 各個畫面怎麼用

下面的畫面都是繁體中文介面（按右上角的「繁中」切換）。

開始畫面

學習畫面：動態是怎麼決定的？

共 6 張卡片：訊號 → 預測 → 循環 → 內建的多樣性 → 你的控制選項 → 像媒體偵探一樣思考。

  • 用下一張／上一張按鈕、左右滑動，或鍵盤的 ← → 換卡片。
  • 第 3 張有會動的循環圖：你停下來 → 程式學到一個訊號 → 顯示更多類似的 → 你看到更多 → 你又停下來。
  • 最後一張有兩個問題，以及「停一下 · 查一查 · 找人幫忙」的小習慣，最後的按鈕是開始玩。

動態畫面：主要的遊玩畫面

每次顯示一則貼文，放在手機造型的框裡。右邊是動態組合圖：5 條彩色長條代表 5 個主題，統計最近 10 則貼文，按下按鈕就會立刻更新。

按鈕意思該貼文主題的分數
👀 繼續看多看了幾秒+3
❤️ 按讚喜歡+2
🔁 分享分享給別人+3
⏭️ 略過很快就滑過去−1
🚫 不感興趣不想看這類內容−4

5 個主題：外表與比較、運動、音樂與藝術、科學與學習、朋友與善意、寵物與搞笑。

「為什麼我會看到這個？」

按貼文下方的這個連結，可以看到模型實際用到的理由，例如「你長時間觀看了 2 則『外表與比較』貼文（+6）」、「這則貼文非常熱門（+1）」。按關閉或鍵盤的 Esc 可以關掉。

「貼文背後」

按下去會把卡片翻面，看看可能被藏起來的事：美顏濾鏡、修圖、重拍很多次、特別挑過的光線和角度、付費推廣、AI 生成的圖片。沒有隱藏任何東西的貼文會寫「沒有隱藏的東西：這則就只是好玩 🙂」，避免大家以為「什麼都是假的」。

鏡子檢查

做完 10 個動作後，右邊會出現鏡子檢查按鈕。這個畫面會顯示分數最高的主題，也就是動態以為你最在意的事，並提出問題：

  • 「這是真正的你，還是只是你停下來看的東西？」
  • 兩個引導問題：我為什麼會喜歡這個？、我看到的真的是全部嗎？

有兩個按鈕：挑戰重寫我的動態或繼續玩。

重寫挑戰

動態一開始就卡在「外表與比較」（約 60%）。你有 12 個動作把它調整回來。

在接下來的 10 則貼文中，同時達成才算成功：
  • 「外表與比較」佔 20% 以下，而且
  • 至少有 3 個主題各佔 15% 以上。
  • 計數器 x / 12 顯示已經用了幾個動作。按現在檢查我的動態可以提前結算（用完 12 個動作會自動結算）。
  • 結果會顯示大大的代碼：WIN-7 表示 7 個動作就成功，TRY-12 表示還沒成功。主持人可以把代碼寫在紙上，程式本身什麼都不會儲存。
  • 按再試一次重玩，或按完成進入最後畫面。
💡 卡關時的小提示：對「外表與比較」的貼文按 🚫 不感興趣，再把獎勵（🔁 或 ❤️）平均分給好幾個不同的主題。如果只獎勵同一個主題，那個主題就會佔滿動態，還是沒辦法成功。想要多樣的動態，就要給多樣的獎勵。

最後畫面

訊息是：「演算法是我們停下來看的東西的鏡子。你可以選擇自己要停在哪裡。」畫面上還有邀請參加學校「真實的我」休息站活動的卡片，以及再玩一次按鈕。

4. 「大腦」的規則

這個大腦是以規則為基礎的簡單模型，每一步都能解釋。所有數字都集中在一個地方（js/algorithm.js 裡的 CONFIG）。

#規則
1分數：每個主題都有分數。👀 +3、❤️ +2、🔁 +3、⏭️ −1、🚫 −4。
2選貼文：下一則貼文來自分數最高的主題。非常熱門的貼文再加 1 分。再加一點點隨機，用來打破同分。
3多樣性：絕不連續出現同一位創作者的貼文；同一個主題連續也不超過兩則。
4探索：每第 5 則貼文，來自你看得最少的主題。
5不重複：所有貼文都出現過一次之前，不會重複。
6可解釋：每則貼文都能顯示出現的理由。
7鏡子：分數最高的主題，就是動態認為你在意的事。

「多樣性」和「探索」是參考 Instagram 和 TikTok 對自己的說明所設計的（見第 8 節）。分數的數字是我們自己訂的，可以調整，也要能說明為什麼這樣訂。

5. 想請你們幫忙檢查的地方

程式裡所有繁體中文都是初稿，我們希望由你們來確認用語是否自然、是否像台灣的同學會說的話。不需要會寫程式，只要看文字就可以了。

要檢查的內容在哪裡看請看什麼
40 則虛構貼文（標題和「貼文背後」的說明）本文件的附錄 A用語是否自然？有沒有不恰當的字眼？「外表」類貼文的語氣是否溫和？
操作介面的文字（按鈕、標題、提示，約 100 句）和 6 張學習卡片本文件的附錄 B，或直接操作程式是否符合台灣習慣？按鈕字數會不會太長？特別請看：「訊號」「過濾氣泡」，以及 Instagram 的功能名稱（動態消息、限時動態、探索、Reels、暫停推薦貼文）。
教育部新聞的引用學習卡片第 3 張和第 6 張，以及鏡子檢查的兩個問題我們寫「臺灣教育部的一堂課說，演算法和商業模式會影響我們喜歡和選擇什麼」；「停一下 · 查一查 · 找人幫忙」；兩個問題「我為什麼會喜歡這個？」「我看到的真的是全部嗎？」，是否貼近原新聞的意思？
「真實的我」休息站最後畫面這是我們對 "Real Me Break" 的暫定翻譯，歡迎提供更好的名稱。

怎麼回覆我們？

  • 最簡單：把附錄列印出來（或直接在檔案上加註解），在最後一欄寫 OK，或寫上建議的說法。
  • 也可以用電子郵件回覆，格式像這樣：位置 + 原文 + 建議說法。例如：「貼文 fr01：『下課時我邀請新同學一起玩我們的遊戲』→ 建議改成『下課時我邀請新同學一起玩遊戲』」。
  • 覺得整體語氣、用詞不適合國中生，也請直接告訴我們。

6. 攤位展示流程（每位約 3–5 分鐘）

如果貴校也想在校內展示，可以參考這個流程。

時間主持人怎麼做
0:00–0:30打招呼並問：「你最常滑哪一類的影片？」然後請對方按開始玩。
0:30–2:00請對方依照自己的喜好按約 10 次，並請他注意右邊彩色長條的變化。
2:00–2:30在一則外表類貼文上按為什麼我會看到這個？和貼文背後，問：「你覺得哪些地方可能被修過？」
2:30–3:00按鏡子檢查，問兩個問題：「這是真正的你嗎？」、「你看到的是全部嗎？」
3:00–4:30重寫挑戰：說明規則，讓對方試試看。對方願意的話，把結果代碼寫在紙上。
4:30–5:00最後畫面。提醒停一下 · 查一查 · 找人幫忙，並邀請參加學校的「真實的我」休息站。
主持人提醒：
  • 不要詢問來賓的姓名、班級、學校或電話。寫在紙上的只有結果代碼，不寫名字。
  • 如果要錄影或拍照，請先向老師確認學校對於拍攝學生臉部和聲音的規定。
  • 要強調這是教學模型，不要說「這就是 TikTok 或 Instagram 的做法」。

7. 遇到問題怎麼辦

狀況處理方式
開啟後只看到空白頁請用真正的瀏覽器（Chrome、Safari）開啟，不要用預覽視窗。還是空白的話：按 Cmd + Option + J（Mac）或 F12（Windows），把「Console」分頁裡的紅色文字截圖傳給我們。
看不到鏡子檢查按鈕一般模式要做滿 10 個動作才會出現（看「目前動作」那一行）。
看不到現在檢查我的動態按鈕挑戰中至少要做 1 個動作才會出現。
「為什麼」視窗關不掉按關閉、點視窗外面的暗色區域，或按 Esc。
切換成中文後，創作者名字還是英文正常：創作者名字是虛構的暱稱，所以不翻譯。
不小心重新整理頁面一切會回到最初（這是刻意的設計，因為程式不儲存任何東西）。按開始玩重新開始即可。
按兩下後用文字編輯器或錯誤的程式開啟在檔案上按右鍵 →「開啟方式」→ 選 Chrome 或 Safari。
信箱不讓你下載 .html 附件改用我們另外附上的 ZIP 版，下載後解壓縮。
想在別台電腦使用把 my-feed-my-mirror-offline.html 複製到那台電腦，按兩下開啟即可。

學習畫面只使用下列來源的資訊。請注意：各平台的說明是公司對自己的描述，可能已經簡化，也可能在發布之後有所改變。

    moe.gov.tw（最新消息，標題如上）

謝謝你們的協助！有任何問題，歡迎隨時告訴我們。🌈

English version

Hello to our partner students and teachers in Kaohsiung! This document introduces the small program we made for ASEP 2026, and we would also like to ask you to check the Traditional Chinese text inside it (see section 5). We are not native Chinese speakers. The Chinese is a first draft written with AI help, so some of it will sound unnatural, and we really need your help. Thank you! 🙏

1. What is it?

My Feed, My Mirror is a small web program that works without internet. It simulates a social-media feed. Players tap 👀 ❤️ 🔁 ⏭️ 🚫 and instantly see how the feed changes.

It helps people notice five things:

1. My actions change the feed.
Watching, liking, sharing and skipping all affect the next post.
2. "Why am I seeing this?"
Every post shows its exact reasons. Nothing is secret.
3. Behind the "perfect" post
There may be filters, editing, many retakes or paid promotion.
4. Mirror Check
What does the feed think you care about most? Is that really you?
5. Rewrite Challenge. A feed has drifted toward appearance and comparison. Can you rebalance it in 12 actions?

There is also a Learn screen (6 cards) explaining how the platforms themselves describe their recommendations. Every card names its source.

Who is it for, and when?

  • Grade 7–8 students and visitors to a STEM corner, about 3–5 minutes each.
  • Runs on a laptop or tablet, fully offline. It has a presenter mode for projectors and screen recording.
  • Competition theme: "Breaking the Algorithm, Rewriting Youth: Youth Building a Safer Campus Ecosystem".

Four safety promises

PromiseWhat it means
🔒 No accountsNo login. It never asks for a name or any personal information.
🧹 Nothing is savedNo cookies, no browser storage. Reloading the page puts everything back to the start.
📴 No internet neededIt never sends or downloads anything. It works with Wi-Fi turned off.
🎭 Every post is made up40 fictional posts. No photos of real people, no real names, no real brands. Pictures are emoji only.

2. How to open it

We send you a file by email: my-feed-my-mirror-offline.html (the program itself, about 65 KB). Everything is inside that one file, and it needs no internet.

  1. Download the attachment to your computer (for example your Downloads or Desktop folder). Please download it first. Do not open it in the email preview window: previews usually cannot run programs and show a blank page.
  2. Double-click the downloaded file. It opens in your browser (Chrome, Safari or Edge).
  3. You should see the start screen with two buttons, Learn first and Play. After that you can even turn Wi-Fi off and it keeps working.
If something goes wrong:
  • It opens in a text editor or another program: right-click the file, choose Open With, then pick Chrome or Safari.
  • Your mailbox or school network blocks .html attachments: we also send a ZIP version, my-feed-my-mirror-offline.zip. Unzip it, then double-click the .html file inside.
  • Phones and tablets: please use a laptop or desktop computer. Mail apps on phones usually cannot run it (we have not tested phones yet).
⚠️ If you open it inside an email preview or a chat-app preview you may see only a blank page, because those windows cannot run JavaScript. Always open it in a real browser.

Language, Restart, presenter mode

  • EN | 繁中 (top right): switches between English and Traditional Chinese. The posts switch too. (There is no Vietnamese version yet.)
  • Restart: goes back to the start screen.
  • Presenter mode: add ?presenter=1 to the very end of the address in the browser's address bar (for example …/my-feed-my-mirror-offline.html?presenter=1) and press Enter. Text and the layout get bigger and animations get slower, which is good for projectors and recording.

3. The screens, one by one

The pictures below are the English interface (use the "EN" button, top right).

Start screen

Learn screen: "How does a feed decide?"

6 cards: Signals → Predictions → The Loop → Built-in variety → Your controls → Think like a media detective.

  • Move with the Next / Back buttons, swipe left or right, or use the ← → keys.
  • Card 3 has a moving loop: you stop on a post → the app learns a signal → it shows more like it → you see more → you stop again.
  • The last card has two questions and the habit Stop · Check · Ask for help. Its button is Play.

Feed screen: the main game

One post at a time, inside a phone-shaped frame. On the right is the feed mix meter: 5 coloured bars for 5 topics, measured over the last 10 posts. It updates the moment you press a button.

ButtonMeaningPoints for the post's topic
👀 Keep watchingStayed a few extra seconds+3
❤️ LikeLiked it+2
🔁 ShareShared it+3
⏭️ SkipScrolled past quickly−1
🚫 Not interestedDoes not want this kind of post−4

The 5 topics: Appearance & Comparison, Sports, Music & Art, Science & Learning, Friends & Kindness, Pets & Funny.

"Why am I seeing this?"

Press this link under a post to see the exact reasons the model used, for example "You watched 2 Appearance & Comparison posts for a long time (+6)" or "This post is very popular (+1)". Press Close or the Esc key to close it.

"Behind the post"

Press it to flip the card and see what may be hidden: a beauty filter, editing, many retakes, carefully chosen light and angle, paid promotion, an AI-made picture. A post with nothing hidden says "Nothing hidden: this one is just fun 🙂", so nobody thinks "everything is fake".

Mirror Check

After 10 actions, a Mirror Check button appears on the right. This screen shows the topic with the most points, which is what the feed thinks you care about most, and asks:

  • "Is this the real you, or just what you stopped on?"
  • Two guiding questions: Why do I like this? and Is what I see really everything?

Two buttons: Try the Rewrite Challenge or Keep playing.

Rewrite Challenge

The feed starts stuck on Appearance (about 60%). You have 12 actions to rebalance it.

You win when, in the next 10 posts, both of these are true:
  • Appearance is 20% or less, and
  • at least 3 topics have 15% or more each.
  • The counter x / 12 shows how many actions you used. Press Check my feed now to finish early (after 12 actions the program checks automatically).
  • The result shows a big code: WIN-7 means you won after 7 actions, TRY-12 means not yet. A facilitator can write the code on paper. The program saves nothing.
  • Press Try again to replay, or Finish to go to the last screen.
💡 Hint if you are stuck: press 🚫 Not interested on Appearance posts, then give rewards (🔁 or ❤️) evenly to several different topics. If you reward only one topic, it takes over the feed and you still will not win. A varied feed needs varied rewards.

End screen

The message: "The algorithm is a mirror of what we stop on. You can choose what you stop on." There is also a card inviting people to the school's Real Me Break activity, and a Play again button.

4. The rules of the "brain"

The brain is a simple rule-based model, so every step can be explained. All the numbers live in one place (CONFIG in js/algorithm.js).

#Rule
1Points: every topic has a score. 👀 +3, ❤️ +2, 🔁 +3, ⏭️ −1, 🚫 −4.
2Choosing: the next post comes from the topic with the most points. A very popular post gets +1. A tiny bit of chance breaks ties.
3Variety: never two posts by the same creator in a row; never more than two posts of the same topic in a row.
4Explore: every 5th post comes from the topic you have seen least.
5No repeats until every post has been shown once.
6Explainable: for every post we can show the reasons.
7Mirror: the topic with the most points is what the feed thinks you care about.

The "variety" and "explore" rules were designed from what Instagram and TikTok say about themselves (see section 8). The point values are our own choices. You can change them, as long as you can explain why.

5. What we would like you to check

All the Traditional Chinese in the program is a first draft. We would like you to tell us whether the wording is natural and sounds like something students in Taiwan would really say. You do not need to know any programming. You only need to read the text.

What to checkWhere to see itWhat to look for
40 made-up posts (captions and the "Behind the post" notes)Appendix A in this documentIs the wording natural? Any unsuitable words? Is the tone of the "appearance" posts gentle?
Interface text (buttons, titles, hints, about 100 lines) and the 6 Learn cardsAppendix B, or just use the programDoes it match Taiwanese usage? Are any button labels too long? Please look especially at 「訊號」「過濾氣泡」 and the Instagram feature names (動態消息, 限時動態, 探索, Reels, 暫停推薦貼文).
The Ministry of Education news we quoteLearn cards 3 and 6, and the Mirror Check questionsWe wrote that a lesson from Taiwan's Ministry of Education says algorithms and business models can influence what we like and choose; the habit 「停一下 · 查一查 · 找人幫忙」; and the two questions 「我為什麼會喜歡這個？」 and 「我看到的真的是全部嗎？」. Do they match the meaning of the original news item?
「真實的我」休息站The last screenThis is our temporary translation of "Real Me Break". A better name is welcome.

How to reply

  • Easiest: print the appendices or add comments to the file, then write OK or your suggested wording in the last column.
  • Or reply by email in this format: where + original text + suggested wording. For example: "Post fr01: 『下課時我邀請新同學一起玩我們的遊戲』 → suggest 『下課時我邀請新同學一起玩遊戲』".
  • If the overall tone or vocabulary does not suit lower-secondary students, please tell us directly.

6. Running a booth (about 3–5 minutes per visitor)

If your school also wants to show it, you can follow this plan.

TimeWhat the facilitator does
0:00–0:30Say hello and ask: "What kind of videos do you scroll through most?" Then ask them to press Play.
0:30–2:00Ask them to press buttons about 10 times as they like, and to watch the coloured bars change.
2:00–2:30On an appearance post, press Why am I seeing this? and Behind the post. Ask: "What do you think may have been edited?"
2:30–3:00Press Mirror Check and ask two questions: "Is this really you?" and "Is what you see everything?"
3:00–4:30Rewrite Challenge: explain the rule and let them try. If they like, write the result code on paper.
4:30–5:00The last screen. Remind them of Stop · Check · Ask for help and invite them to the school's "Real Me Break".
Reminders for facilitators:
  • Do not ask visitors for their name, class, school or phone number. Write only the result code on paper, never a name.
  • If you film or photograph the booth, first ask your teachers about your school's rules on filming students' faces and voices.
  • Stress that this is a teaching model. Do not say "this is how TikTok or Instagram does it".

7. If something goes wrong

What you seeWhat to do
Only a blank pageOpen the file in a real browser (Chrome, Safari), not in a preview window. If it is still blank: press Cmd + Option + J (Mac) or F12 (Windows), then send us a screenshot of the red text in the "Console" tab.
The file opens as text or in the wrong programRight-click the file → Open With → Chrome or Safari.
The email will not let you download the .html fileUse the ZIP version we also attached, then unzip it.
No Mirror Check buttonIn normal play it appears only after 10 actions (see the "Actions so far" line).
No Check my feed now buttonIn the challenge it appears after at least 1 action.
The "Why" window will not closePress Close, click the dark area outside it, or press Esc.
Creator names stay in English after switching to ChineseNormal: creator names are made-up nicknames, so they are not translated.
You reloaded the page by accidentEverything goes back to the start (this is on purpose, because the program saves nothing). Press Play to begin again.
Want to use it on another computerCopy my-feed-my-mirror-offline.html to that computer and double-click it.

8. Sources for the Learn screen

The Learn screen uses only the sources below. Please note that each platform's description is what the company says about itself. It may be simplified, and it may have changed since it was published.

  • Instagram, "Instagram Ranking Explained" (Adam Mosseri, May 2023)
    about.instagram.com/blog/announcements/instagram-ranking-explained
  • TikTok Newsroom, "How TikTok recommends videos #ForYou" (June 2020)
    newsroom.tiktok.com/how-tiktok-recommends-videos-for-you?lang=en
  • YouTube Help, "How YouTube recommendations work"
    support.google.com/youtube/answer/16089387?hl=en

    moe.gov.tw (news section, title as above)

These addresses are only for teachers who want to check. The program itself never opens or downloads them.

Thank you for your help! Please tell us anything at any time. 🌈

learn.1.titleSignals訊號
learn.1.bodyApps say they look at many small clues, called signals. Examples they name: what you like, share and comment on, how long you watch, and your watch and search history. A strong signal, like watching a long video to the end, counts more than a weak one.各個應用程式說，它們會看很多小線索，叫做「訊號」。它們提到的例子有：你按讚、分享、留言的內容，你看了多久，還有你的觀看和搜尋紀錄。像把長影片看到最後這種強訊號，比弱訊號更重要。
learn.1.oursIn our game: Watch +{w}, Like +{l}, Share +{s}, Skip {k}, Not interested {x}.在我們的遊戲裡：繼續看 +{w}、按讚 +{l}、分享 +{s}、略過 {k}、不感興趣 {x}。
learn.2.titlePredictions預測
learn.2.bodyInstagram says there is no single algorithm. Feed, Stories, Explore and Reels each rank posts in their own way. In Feed, it looks most closely at how likely you are to spend a few seconds on a post, like, comment, share, or tap the profile.Instagram 說，並沒有單一的演算法。動態消息、限時動態、探索和 Reels 各有自己的排序方式。在動態消息裡，它最仔細看的是：你有多可能多看幾秒、按讚、留言、分享，或點進個人檔案。
learn.3.titleThe Loop循環
learn.3.bodyEach time you stop on a post, the app learns a signal and shows you more like it. Then you see more of it, and you stop again. A Taiwan Ministry of Education lesson says algorithms and business models can influence what we like and choose.每次你停在一則貼文上，應用程式就學到一個訊號，並給你看更多類似的。然後你看到更多，又再停下來。臺灣教育部的一堂課說，演算法和商業模式會影響我們喜歡和選擇什麼。
learn.3.oursThe loop picture is our own simplified drawing.這個循環圖是我們自己畫的簡化版。
loop.1You stop on a post你停在一則貼文上
loop.2The app learns a signal應用程式學到一個訊號
loop.3It shows more like it它顯示更多類似的
loop.4You see more of it你看到更多
loop.5You stop again你又停下來
learn.4.titleBuilt-in variety內建的多樣性
learn.4.bodyInstagram says it tries not to show too many posts from the same person in a row. TikTok says it generally avoids two videos in a row with the same sound or creator. TikTok also names the “filter bubble” risk and says it mixes in different videos.Instagram 說，它會盡量不連續顯示太多同一個人的貼文。TikTok 說，它通常會避免連續兩支影片用同一個音樂或來自同一位創作者。TikTok 也提到「過濾氣泡」的風險，並說它會混入不同的影片。
learn.4.oursIn our game: this is the diversity rule and the Explore pick.在我們的遊戲裡：這就是多樣性規則和探索推薦。
learn.5.titleYour controls你的控制選項
learn.5.introApps say you can:各個應用程式說，你可以：
learn.5.i1Tap “Not interested” (Instagram, TikTok)點「不感興趣」（Instagram、TikTok）
learn.5.i2Hide a creator or a sound (TikTok)隱藏某位創作者或某個音樂（TikTok）
learn.5.i3Snooze suggested posts, or mute or unfollow (Instagram)暫停推薦貼文，或是靜音、取消追蹤（Instagram）
learn.5.i4Ask “Why you’re seeing this post” (Instagram)查看「為什麼你會看到這則貼文」（Instagram）
learn.5.i5Remove recommendations, or pause or clear your watch and search history (YouTube)移除推薦，或暫停、清除觀看和搜尋紀錄（YouTube）
learn.6.titleThink like a media detective像媒體偵探一樣思考
learn.6.introAsk yourself two questions:問自己兩個問題：
learn.6.habitStop · Check · Ask for help停一下 · 查一查 · 找人幫忙
learn.6.habit.bodyWhen you meet a rumour, a suspicious message or an AI-made picture: stop, check the source, notice the risk, and ask a trusted person for help.遇到謠言、可疑訊息或 AI 生成的圖片時：先停下來，查證來源，留意風險，再請信任的人幫忙。
